caption:
Six rules. One kill switch.
max_daily_loss, profit_target, max_trades, kill_time, kill_days, kill_dates. Your rule fires: every pending order is cancelled, every position is squared off at market, and the account stays locked until close.
Monthly ₹999 at the time of posting. 7-day free trial, no card.
